requirements: R1: Patch the existing code to synchronize internal task states with actual GitHub PR states and eliminate discrepancies.

slices.title: Patch task state to match GitHub PR reality
slices.jtbd: When implementing the state reconciliation patch for this epic, I want to correct the synchronization logic, so that internal records match actual GitHub PR states and blocked tasks are visible.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task internally marked as done while its GitHub PR remains open,
When the status synchronization patch executes,
Then the internal task status must be corrected using an atomically-guarded update to reflect the actual PR state,
And the synchronization logic must be fully verified by unit tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce task status discrepancies between internal records and GitHub from the observed baseline of 3 OPERATIONAL_REALITY_FINDING nodes to 0 occurrences.
